name: parra-glideator
description: Read-only paragliding planning tools powered by Parra-Glideator forecast-derived XC potential and site data.

interface.shortDescription: Compare paragliding sites and forecast-derived XC potential.
interface.longDescription: Use Parra-Glideator's read-only MCP tools to compare paragliding sites for specific dates, inspect forecast-derived XC potential and historical seasonality, find takeoffs and landings, and discover curated local resources. Decision support only: verify current conditions, local rules, airspace, access, and pilot suitability before flying.
defaultPrompt: Use Parra-Glideator to find the most promising paragliding sites for this weekend.
Use Parra-Glideator to compare 50-point XC potential for paragliding sites near me next week.
